title: Ankyros Prime
extract:
The Ankyros Prime is the Prime version of  Ankyros fists, acting as a direct upgrade. It was released alongside  Rhino Prime and  Boltor Prime.

Characteristics

Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Fracturing Wind and  Quaking Hand (Conclave only) stance.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On February 9th, 2016, it was announced that Ankyros Prime, alongside  Rhino Prime and  Boltor Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on February 16th, 2016. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.
Ankyros Prime, alongside  Rhino Prime,  Boltor Prime,  Mag Prime,  Boar Prime, and  Dakra Prime, were unvaulted on June 27, 2017 to August 1, 2017.
Ankyros Prime, along with  Rhino Prime,  Boltor Prime,  Nyx Prime,  Hikou Prime, and  Scindo Prime, was once again unvaulted on July 24, 2018 to September 25, 2018.
The same line-up resurfaced from July 16th, 2019 to September 3rd, 2019.

Trivia
Ankyros Prime is the first Gauntlet melee weapon to be primed.
Compared to previous Prime weapons, the Ankyros and the Ankyros Prime have a much closer resemblance to each other – their model geometry is nearly identical.
